posts.title: Welcome to the brand new FewClicks website!
posts.summary: We built a home on the web that's as playful as our games. Poke around, there are secrets hidden everywhere.
body: Hello world! FewClicks finally has a proper home on the internet. Everything here is built to feel like our games: quick, bouncy and fun within a few clicks.
Keep an eye on this page for devlogs, launch news and the occasional blob-related emergency.

posts.title: Blobby Pop Season 2: Jelly Jungle is live
posts.summary: 60 new levels, Vine Blobs that swing between columns, and a brand new Jungle Jelly Bomb.
body: Season 2 takes the blobs into the Jelly Jungle! We've added 60 new levels, a new Vine Blob that swings between columns, and the Jungle Jelly Bomb, which clears an entire row with a very loud monkey noise.
Update your game from the App Store or Google Play to start swinging.

posts.title: Devlog #3: How we design games you can learn in 3 clicks
posts.summary: Our golden rule: if a new player can't have fun within three taps, it's back to the drawing board.
body: Every FewClicks game goes through the Three Click Test. We hand a prototype to someone who has never seen it, say nothing, and count the taps until they smile.
If it takes more than three, we cut, simplify and try again. In this devlog we show the five versions of Rocket Tap that failed the test, and the one that passed.

posts.title: Neon Drift Club announced for PC and consoles
posts.summary: Our first arcade racer drifts onto Steam, PlayStation, Xbox and Switch this December. Wishlist now!
body: Buckle up! Neon Drift Club is our biggest game yet: an arcade drift racer where every slide paints the city in light.
It launches this December on Steam, PlayStation, Xbox and Nintendo Switch. Wishlist it on Steam to get notified the moment the lights turn green.
